name: Naito Akita
source:
An ordinary high school student attending a local high school.
He lives alone in his parents' house because they are working overseas.
It's his daily routine to come to school early in the morning, before anyone else has even arrived.

[From the [url=http://www.wabin-project.com/works/reversible/character.html]official website[/url]]
